name: GB1900 Gazetteer
description: Place names transcribed by volunteers from the six-inch Ordnance Survey maps of around 1900.
licence: Raw Dump CC0; Complete and Abridged CC BY-SA
conditions: We use the Raw Dump (CC0). Works derived from it must not use the name GB1900; cite the 'GB1900 final raw gazetteer data dump'. Complete/Abridged versions are CC BY-SA (share-alike), not used.
plan: Hosted as 'Old map names (OS six-inch, c.1900)', Newbury and West Berkshire first (WP3).

name: Wikidata
description: Structured data about people, places and organisations. Useful context, not genealogical proof.
plan: Live search connector (WP3).
conditions: No attribution or commercial limits on the data. API clients must send a descriptive User-Agent.

name: The National Archives: Discovery
description: Catalogue descriptions of records held by The National Archives and thousands of other archives. Descriptions, not the documents themselves.
licence: Open Government Licence cited on one page
conditions: API terms: register by emailing webmaster@nationalarchives.gov.uk with the server's IP address; do not cache or store any content returned; no more than 3,000 calls a day, at most one a second.
plan: Live connector built (WP6); switched on by TNA_DISCOVERY_ENABLED once registered. Nothing it returns is stored (ADR-034).

name: Europeana
description: European cultural heritage objects: photographs, artworks, papers, film and sound from many institutions.
conditions: Metadata CC0, commercial use allowed. Production services need a project API key (personal keys are for individual, non-production use). Keys must not be shared. Media rights per item (edm:rights).
plan: Live connector built (WP6); switched on when EUROPEANA_API_KEY is set (ADR-034).
licence: Metadata CC0 1.0; each item has its own rights statement

name: OpenHistoricalMap
description: Time-aware map data: roads, buildings and boundaries with start and end dates.
plan: Test for the time map; check Newbury coverage.

name: FamilySearch
description: Global genealogical indexes and images, and a shared family tree. Free account needed.
api_status: Developer programme; partners need a business plan
conditions: Access varies by collection.
plan: Link out; apply for API access early.

name: A Vision of Britain through Time
description: Historical statistics, boundaries and place descriptions; recommends NLS maps for historic OS mapping.
conditions: Statistics open; boundaries limit commercial use; parish boundaries commercially licensed.
plan: Later context layer.

name: Free UK Genealogy (FreeBMD, FreeCEN, FreeREG)
description: Volunteer transcriptions: civil birth, marriage and death indexes for England and Wales (FreeBMD), census (FreeCEN) and parish registers (FreeREG). Coverage is partial and varies by county and year.
licence: ODbL stated, but sharing hasn't started
conditions: Commercial use not directly addressed.
plan: Link out, then contact them.

name: Integrated Census Microdata (I-CeM)
holder: University of Essex / UK Data Service
description: About 230 million census person records, 1851–1921.
conditions: Names and addresses need a special licence; commercial use not addressed.
plan: Research use only until cleared.

name: General Register Office
description: Official birth, marriage and death certificates and indexes for England and Wales. Certificates are paid.
plan: Link out and explain how to order.

name: Findmypast
description: Subscription site with census (including the 1921 census), parish, military and newspaper records.
conditions: Licensing conversation needed.
plan: Link out; explore a partnership.

name: Ancestry
description: Subscription site with census, parish, military records and user family trees.
plan: Directory only; users can import their own GEDCOM exports.

name: ScotlandsPeople
description: Scottish births, marriages, deaths, census and other records. Pay per record.
plan: Link out.

name: British Newspaper Archive
description: Very large collection of digitised British and Irish newspapers. Subscription.
conditions: Run by Findmypast, a potential competitor.
plan: Link out, then ask about licensing.

name: Living with Machines newspaper metadata (LwMDB)
description: Metadata on 19th-century newspapers (titles, places, dates), not the articles.
licence: Code MIT; data licence to confirm
plan: Newspaper discovery by place and title.

name: Newbury Weekly News archive
description: Back issues of the local newspaper. Access through the publisher and local libraries; not online here.
plan: A valuable local partnership: contact the publisher.

name: Berkshire Record Office
description: County archive holding local records, including licensing records for pubs, parish registers and local authority papers. Mostly visited in person; catalogue online.
plan: Contact as a launch partner.

name: West Berkshire Museum
description: Local museum in Newbury with objects and photographs. Credited as the source of some historic pub photos online.
plan: Contact as a launch partner.

name: Pub Wiki (pubwiki.co.uk)
description: Pub histories compiled from census returns and trade directories, with licensee lists by year.
conditions: Reuse not confirmed. We store our own short factual claims with links (ADR-018).
plan: Link and invite the owner as a contributor.

name: Closed Pubs (closedpubs.co.uk)
description: Listings and photographs of pubs that have closed, by county.
conditions: Reuse not confirmed; photos credited to third parties. We store our own short factual claims with links (ADR-018).
plan: Link and invite as a contributor.

name: Nickbits local history blog
description: Local history research on Newbury pubs, drawing on newspapers and census returns.
conditions: Reuse not confirmed. We store our own short factual claims with links (ADR-018).
plan: Invite as an early historian.

name: Historic England Archive
description: Building records and historic photographs of England.
conditions: Check image rights item by item.
plan: Link; check image rights item by item.

name: National Library of Scotland maps
description: Extensive digitised historic Ordnance Survey maps for the whole of Great Britain, including town plans.
conditions: Map images have conditions; terms not checked.
plan: Priority check for time-map layers.

name: Heritage Gateway
description: Search across local and national historic environment records.
plan: Directory.

name: Wikimedia Commons
description: Openly licensed images and media, each file with its own licence.
conditions: Per-file licences and attribution.
plan: Photo connector showing each file's licence.

name: Internet Archive
description: Digitised books, film, audio and archived websites. Rights vary by item.
conditions: Item-level rights.
plan: Connector respecting item-level rights.

name: British History Online
description: Primary and secondary sources for British history, including the Victoria County History.
plan: Directory; assess permissions.

name: Commonwealth War Graves Commission
description: Records of Commonwealth war dead from the two World Wars and their graves and memorials.
plan: Directory, then check data access.

name: Lives of the First World War
description: Life stories of people who served in the First World War.
plan: Directory and possible links.

name: Imperial War Museums collections
description: Photographs, oral histories, film and objects about conflict since 1914.
plan: Catalogue and permissions.

name: A Street Near You
description: First World War records mapped to the places people lived.
plan: Design reference and possible partner.

name: Old Bailey Online
description: Proceedings of London's central criminal court, 1674–1913.
plan: Later specialist connector.

name: Archives Hub
description: Descriptions of archive collections held by UK universities and other institutions.
plan: Evaluate interfaces.

name: Historic Hansard
description: UK parliamentary debates, useful for mentions of people, places and events.
plan: Later.

name: British Film Institute archive
description: Historic film and television, some playable on BFI Player.
plan: Outbound links only.

name: Ordnance Survey OpenData
description: Modern UK reference geography. Not historical.
plan: OS Names connector built (WP6) for finding where addresses are today; switched on when OS_DATA_HUB_KEY is set.
conditions: OS Names API: free for any purpose; needs an OS Data Hub key. Attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right.

name: Trove (National Library of Australia)
description: Australian newspapers from 1803 into the 1950s with searchable text, plus books, photos and archives. Useful for relatives who emigrated.
conditions: Commercial use needs the National Library of Australia's explicit permission (commercial access level) and must acknowledge Trove and the NLA. Keys expire after 12 months.
plan: Live newspaper connector built (WP6); switched on when TROVE_API_KEY is set, after NLA permission for commercial use.

name: DigitalNZ (incl. Papers Past)
holder: National Library of New Zealand / DigitalNZ
description: New Zealand collections, including Papers Past newspapers, photos and archives. Useful for relatives who emigrated.
api_status: Public API; key needed for commercial use
licence: DigitalNZ Developer API terms (commercial terms for selected metadata)
conditions: Commercial use only with an API key and only for selected metadata. Name the original source and link via source_url for each item. 10,000 calls a day per key. Remove items that are withdrawn.
plan: Live connector built (WP6); switched on when DIGITALNZ_API_KEY is set.

name: Digital Public Library of America
description: Photos, documents, books and maps from US libraries, archives and museums. Useful for relatives who emigrated.
licence: Metadata CC0; items have their own rights
conditions: Metadata released CC0 (no restriction on commercial use). Item rights vary.
plan: Live connector built (WP6) from the documented API; switched on when DPLA_API_KEY is set. API terms page couldn't be read automatically: confirm before launch.

name: Geograph Britain and Ireland
description: Photos of places across Britain and Ireland, mostly taken since 2005, with locations. Shows what streets and buildings look like today and in recent decades.
conditions: Credit the photographer beside each image, say it's Creative Commons and link the photo page. Adapted images must be shared alike. No bulk collection or model training through the live API.
plan: Live photo connector built (WP6); switched on when GEOGRAPH_API_KEY is set.

name: National Heritage List for England
description: Every listed building, scheduled monument, registered park and garden, and battlefield in England, with grade, listing date and exact location.
api_status: Open ArcGIS feature service, no key
conditions: OGL. Attribution: © Historic England; contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right. Listing date is not build date.
plan: Live connector for listed buildings (WP6). Other layers (scheduled monuments, parks, battlefields, conservation areas, Heritage at Risk) and a time-map layer can follow.

name: The Gazette
holder: The Stationery Office for the Crown
description: The UK's official public record since 1665: military commissions and promotions, honours, bankruptcies, dissolved partnerships, deceased estates.
api_status: Open JSON/Atom search and linked data, no key
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (not covering personal data)
conditions: OGL does not cover re-use of personal data. Fair use: identifiable User-Agent, at most 5 requests every 10 seconds, respect 429 Retry-After; bulk crawling at night only.
plan: Live connector (WP6), limited to notices at least 100 years old so living people stay out (ADR-035).

name: GeoNames
description: Worldwide place names with other spellings, types and locations.
api_status: Free account name; 10,000 credits a day, 1,000 an hour
conditions: Commercial use allowed; credit GeoNames with a link. Premium service with an SLA for heavy use.
plan: Live connector built (WP6); switched on when GEONAMES_USERNAME is set.

name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art collection
description: Nearly 500,000 objects, from paintings and photographs to clothing and tools; public-domain objects have images.
api_status: Open API, no key; at most 80 requests a second
licence: Open Access data CC0; images for public-domain objects
conditions: CC0 for commercial and non-commercial use; data also identifies works still in copyright, whose images aren't provided.
plan: Live connector (WP6) for context: what objects of a period looked like.

name: Art Institute of Chicago collection
description: Around 130,000 artworks and objects, many public domain with images.
licence: Data CC0; descriptions CC BY (not used)
conditions: CC0 for data; description field CC BY 4.0, which we don't request. Identify the client with an AIC-User-Agent header.
plan: Live connector (WP6) for context.

name: OpenAlex
description: Over 250 million scholarly works: articles, books and theses, including local and family history research.
api_status: No key needed; a free key raises the daily budget
conditions: Keyless use shares a small daily budget per IP address; a free key gives each user their own.
plan: Live connector (WP6); set OPENALEX_API_KEY for production.
